# pve_user (Data Source)

One API user's configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_user" "example" {
  userid = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `userid` (String) Full User ID, in the `name@realm` format.

### Optional

- `multiple` (Boolean) Request all entries as an array. (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `api_tokens` (Attributes List) Returned by /access/users/{userid}/token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_tokens))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <userid>.
- `tfa_entries` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tfa_entries))
- `user` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))

<a id="nestedatt--api_tokens"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_tokens`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String)
- `expire` (Number) API token expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date.
- `privsep` (Boolean) Restrict API token privileges with separate ACLs (default), or give full privileges of corresponding user.
- `tokenid` (String) User-specific token identifier.


<a id="nestedatt--tfa_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tfa_entries`

Read-Only:

- `realm` (String) The type of TFA the users realm has set, if any.
- `types` (List of String) Array of the user configured TFA types, if any. Only available if 'multiple' was not passed.
- `user` (String) The type of TFA the user has set, if any. Only set if 'multiple' was not passed.


<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String)
- `email` (String)
- `enable` (Boolean) Enable the account (default). You can set this to '0' to disable the account
- `expire` (Number) Account expiration date (seconds since epoch). '0' means no expiration date.
- `firstname` (String)
- `groups` (List of String)
- `keys` (String) Keys for two factor auth (yubico).
- `lastname` (String)
- `tokens` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user--tokens))
